_doc._about: Pre-registration for the FR-5.2 promotion gate (PRD.md FR-5.2, PRD_STRATEGY_FACTORY.md FR-F3.4, docs/factory/FACTORY_ARCHITECTURE.md section 9 item 8). Copy to configs/factory/gate_registration.json, fill every REPLACE_ME, and COMMIT IT BEFORE THE FIRST PAPER TRADE of the promoted genome. scripts/gate.py reads this file and refuses to pass a run whose registration does not match the promoted spec. The file is timestamp-free on purpose: the commit that adds it is the timestamp (see registered_before_first_trade).
_doc.schema_version: Integer. Bump when the meaning of any field changes; gate.py refuses unknown versions.
_doc.strategy_name: Exact Strategy.name the sandbox writes into the journal's strategy_name ('Genome <id8>'). Only rows with this name are gated.
_doc.promoted_spec_path: Repo-relative path to the promoted spec JSON. gate.py loads it through src.factory.promoted.load_promoted when that module exists (which verifies the spec's own hash), else it reads the file's spec_hash field, else it hashes the file bytes (CRLF-normalised sha256).
_doc.spec_hash: The promoted spec's spec_hash at registration time. Condition 'spec_hash_unchanged' requires the spec loaded at gate time to carry exactly this value: a genome that was edited after registration is a different genome and its paper record does not count.
_doc.market_family: Series prefix the gate admits (weather = KXHIGH). Rows outside it are ignored, never counted.
_doc.grouping_unit: Independence unit. 'target_date': every settled trade on the same settlement day is one trial, because every bracket on a city-day ladder settles against the same CLI daily high. n counts units, not fills.
_doc.unit_win_rule: How a unit's outcome is decided: 'date_pnl_gt_0' = the unit's summed net PnL (closed_trades pnl minus entry_fee) is strictly positive. A unit with net PnL exactly 0 is a loss.
_doc.thresholds.n_min: Minimum number of settled units before the binomial test may run. Below it gate.py REFUSES (exit 3) rather than reporting an underpowered p.
_doc.thresholds.alpha: One-sided significance level. Condition 'p_lt_alpha' is p < alpha, strict.
_doc.thresholds.net_pnl_gt: Condition 'net_pnl_gt_0' is sum over settled units of (pnl - entry_fee) > this value (0.0). PnL is read from closed_trades / the journal, never from equity or balance (the UTC-midnight reset double-subtracts).
_doc.test: Exact Poisson-binomial upper tail, no scipy: each settled unit u wins under the null with w_u = P[sum over its fills of (won_i - p_i - f_i) qty_i > 0], won_i ~ Bernoulli(q*_i) independent, enumerated exactly over the unit's 2^m fill outcomes; p = P[K >= k] for K = sum_u Bernoulli(w_u), by dynamic programming in fractions.Fraction. With one fill per unit this is the plain binomial with q*. The pooled q_bar binomial is printed as p_pooled_qbar_secondary (approximation, non-gating).
_doc.breakeven: Per fill bought at price p with entry fee f per contract and held to settlement (payout 1, no settlement fee): win pays 1 - p - f, loss pays -(p + f); q*(1-p-f) - (1-q*)(p+f) = 0 gives q* = p + f. Each fill keeps its own q* in the exact unit null (see test); the contract-weighted unit breakeven and the pooled q_bar are diagnostics only.
_doc.fee_type: Fee leg the sandbox books. 'taker': fills are booked with is_maker=False, so the entry fee is fee_calculator.taker_fee at actual quantity (ceil to the cent on the order total). Under a taker registration the gate charges each fill max(booked entry_fee / qty, taker fee recomputed at the fill's price and the journal quantity) -- the recompute happens for every fill, so a maker-booked or missing fee can never lower the breakeven -- and a fill booked as a maker fails the gating condition fee_type_matches.
_doc.adverse_fill: The allowance the promoted strategy adds to the quote (limit_price = quote + adverse_fill). Recorded so the paper record can be re-read against the fill-realism study (scripts/measure_fill_realism.py); if that study raises adverse_fill the family must be re-scored and the registration re-issued, it is not edited in place.
_doc.contracts_frame: Order size the lab frame priced fees at (20). The sandbox's Kelly sizing differs (CONTRA 10); scripts/factory_paper_reconcile.py reports per-contract numbers at actual qty.
_doc.settled_only: Only rows closed by settlement count (close_reason EXPIRATION, exit_price in {0,1}, settlement_outcome recorded). SETTLEMENT_UNRESOLVED and every traded-out close are excluded and listed under 'excluded'.
_doc.registered_before_first_trade: Gating condition. registration_commit_utc must hold the ISO-8601 committer date of the commit that ADDED gate_registration.json (fill it from `git log --diff-filter=A --format=%cI -- configs/factory/gate_registration.json` and commit that edit too); gate.py enforces min(entry_time of settled fills) >= registration_commit_utc. While it is null the condition FAILS ('registration commit time not recorded'); `--allow-unverified-registration` downgrades it to a reported, non-gating line for dry runs only and is recorded in the verdict.
_doc.registration_commit_utc: null until filled (see registered_before_first_trade). The gate FAILS until it is filled.
_doc.requires_realistic_fills: PRD FR-5.2: the gate is evaluated ONLY on runs whose fills were produced with the exchange's realistic-fill model enabled (SimulatedExchange.realistic_fills -- a resting order in the $0.01-$0.05 penny floor fills with probability < 1 and carries an adverse-selection penalty). true means the gate must be able to EVIDENCE that; an unevidenced run is REFUSED (exit 3), never quietly passed. HOW TO EVIDENCE IT: run the sandbox with MP_REALISTIC_FILLS=1, which makes scripts/run_dashboard.py apply the flag to the exchange and append its EFFECTIVE fill configuration (read back off the exchange, not off the environment) to data/fill_config.jsonl at startup, on every book movement, on a 300 s heartbeat and on shutdown; then run gate.py with --fill-config pointing at that log. gate.py groups the log into per-run time windows and requires every admitted settled fill's entry_time to fall inside a window that recorded realistic_fills=true, so the evidence is about the run that made the trades and a stale or absent log answers 'unknown' rather than 'yes'. EVERY EDGE OF A WINDOW IS PINNED TO AN INSTANT THE RUN ACTUALLY STAMPED, because every field is text somebody could type: it closes at the run's stop record or at its last stamp plus its own declared heartbeat grace (capped at 900 s); it opens at the claimed run_started_utc clamped to no earlier than the run's first stamp minus that same cap; a record dated in the future is dropped; and a run evidences nothing until it carries a start record AND a strictly later one, so no single line can ever cover a record. WHAT COUNTS, in precedence order: (1) a realistic_fills key in exchange_state.json if the engine ever serialises one, (2) the fill-config log, (3) --realistic-fills true|false, the operator's typed assertion. Sources that CONTRADICT each other refuse. STRENGTH, precisely: the log is machine-written, time-structured and hash-pinned into the verdict (inputs.fill_config_log_sha256). It is evidence, not proof, and it is NOT tamper-proof -- it is plain JSONL written by the same host that writes the journal, so whoever can write the journal can write it. It does defend against a silently absent, stale, truncated or crashed-run log (all answer 'unknown', so the gate refuses), against an operator assertion that contradicts it (refuses rather than overrides), and against ANY SINGLE forged line (bounded on all three edges as above; before 2026-09-05 one line claiming run_started_utc 1970 and observed_utc 2030 was enough to make the gate print PASS). It does NOT defend against two coherent past-dated lines -- a start and a later stop bracketing the record -- which are shaped exactly like a genuine short run's log and cannot be told apart without a signature or an off-host witness. Read this condition as 'the run that made these trades recorded this fill configuration', never as 'these trades provably had realistic fills'. SCOPE: the modelled effect is about RESTING orders, so a taker family (fee_type 'taker', fills crossing the spread) is barely affected by enabling it; that is a reason the condition is cheap to satisfy for takers, NOT a reason to register false. Set false only for a family where the fill model is genuinely irrelevant, and say why in the promotion record -- false makes the condition non-gating.
_doc._fill_config_log: data/fill_config.jsonl, written by scripts/run_dashboard.py:OrchestratorEngine. Not part of this registration; recorded here so a reader knows where the realistic-fills evidence comes from and that gate.py takes its path from --fill-config.

registered_before_first_trade: This file must be committed before the first paper trade of strategy_name; verify with `git log --diff-filter=A -- configs/factory/gate_registration.json` against the first journal row.
